_about: SHELF of Italian classics in English before 1931: Goldoni's Memoirs (John Black), Four Comedies (Clifford Bax and others), The Liar (Grace Lovat Fraser) and Goldoni on Playwriting (van Steenderen); Alfieri's Tragedies (Charles Lloyd, 1815) and Autobiography (C. Edwards Lester, 1845); and six Carducci translations (Sewall, Arms, Holland, Bickersteth, Gilbert, Tribe). Bowring's Alfieri, Hoole's Metastasio and Aldington's Goldoni are on those translators' shelves. Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 92); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check. Common-word surnames (black, lloyd, fraser, holland, arms, tribe, gilbert, bax) are never listed bare.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.
